questions.stem:
9. The radius and the area of a sector are \(12\) cm and \(30\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the angle of the sector.

(b) Express the perimeter of the sector in terms of \(\pi\).
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
9. 扇形的半徑及面積分別為 \(12\) cm 及 \(30\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求扇形的圓心角。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示扇形的周界。
（5 分）
questions.hint: Radius and sector area → find the fraction of a full circle.
questions.hintZh: 已知半徑及扇形面積 → 先求佔整圓的比例。
questions.solution: (a) Let the central angle be \(\theta^\circ\). The sector occupies \(\theta/360\) of the circle, so \[\frac{\theta}{360}\pi(12)^2=30\pi.\] Cancel \(\pi\) and solve to obtain \(\theta=75\). The angle is \(75^\circ\). (b) The arc has the same fraction of the full circumference: \[s=\frac{75}{360}\times2\pi(12)=5\pi\text{ cm}.\] The perimeter includes the arc and both radii: \[P=5\pi+12+12=(24+5\pi)\text{ cm}.\] Check: \(\frac12rs=\frac12(12)(5\pi)=30\pi\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設圓心角為 θ°。扇形佔圓的 θ/360：
\[
\frac{\theta}{360}\pi(12)^2=30\pi.
\]
消去 π 解得 θ = 75。角度為 75°。
（b）弧長佔圓周同樣比例：
\[
s=\frac{75}{360}\times2\pi(12)=5\pi\text{ cm}.
\]
周界包括弧及兩條半徑：
\[
P=5\pi+12+12=(24+5\pi)\text{ cm}.
\]

questions.stem: 6. There is a cylinder with radius \(A \mathrm{~cm}\) and height \(2 A \mathrm{~cm}\). There is also a hemisphere with radius \(\frac{7}{5} \mathrm{Acm}\). Someone claims that the total surface area of the cylinder is larger than the total surface area of the hemisphere. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh: 6. 有一個半徑為 \(A\) cm、高為 \(2A\) cm 的圓柱。另有一個半徑為 \(\frac{7}{5}A\) cm 的半球。某人聲稱圓柱的總表面積大於半球的總表面積。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Total surface area comparison → list every exposed face.
questions.hintZh: 比較總表面積 → 先逐個數外露面。
questions.solution: Total surface area includes all exposed curved and flat faces. The cylinder has two circular ends and one curved surface: \(S_C=2\pi A^2+2\pi(A)(2A)=6\pi A^2.\) The hemisphere has half a spherical surface and one circular base: \(S_H=3\pi\left(\frac75A\right)^2=\frac{147}{25}\pi A^2.\) Their difference is \(S_C-S_H=\frac3{25}\pi A^2>0\) since \(A>0\). The cylinder has the greater total surface area, so the claim is correct.
questions.solutionZh:
總表面積包括所有外露曲面及平面。圓柱有兩個圓形端面及一個曲面：
\[
S_C=2\pi A^2+2\pi(A)(2A)=6\pi A^2.
\]
半球有半個球面及一個圓形底面：
\[
S_H=3\pi\left(\frac75A\right)^2=\frac{147}{25}\pi A^2.
\]
兩者相差：
\[
S_C-S_H=\frac3{25}\pi A^2>0.
\]
圓柱總表面積較大，故聲稱正確。

questions.stem:
5. Consider the sector \(OABC\) of area \(1215\pi\text{ cm}^2\). The angle of the sector is \(216^\circ\).

(a) Find the radius of the sector.

(b) By joining \(OA\) and \(OC\) together, \(OABC\) is folded to form an inverted right circular conical vessel. Express the capacity of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
5. 扇形 \(OABC\) 的面積為 \(1215\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，圓心角為 \(216^\circ\)。

(a) 求扇形的半徑。

(b) 將 \(OA\) 及 \(OC\) 接合，把 \(OABC\) 摺成一個倒置直立圓錐形容器。以 \(\pi\) 表示該容器的容量。
（4 分）
questions.hint: Rolled sector → radius becomes slant height; arc becomes circumference.
questions.hintZh: 扇形捲成圓錐 → 半徑變斜高，弧變底圓周。
questions.solution: (a) Let the sector radius be \(l\) cm. The sector-area formula gives \[\frac{216}{360}\pi l^2=1215\pi \Rightarrow l^2=2025.\] Taking the positive root, \(l=45\) cm. (b) The sector radius becomes the cone slant height, and the arc becomes the base circumference. For base radius \(r\), \[2\pi r=\frac{216}{360}\times2\pi(45)=54\pi, r=27.\] Pythagoras gives the perpendicular height: \[h=\sqrt{45^2-27^2}=36\text{ cm}.\] The capacity is \[V=\frac13\pi(27)^2(36)=8748\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Check: \(\pi rl=\pi(27)(45)=1215\pi\), equal to the original sector area.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設扇形半徑為 l cm。扇形面積公式：
\[
\frac{216}{360}\pi l^2=1215\pi \Rightarrow l^2=2025.
\]
取正根，l = 45 cm。
（b）扇形半徑成為圓錐斜高，弧長成為底圓周。設底半徑 r：
\[
2\pi r=\frac{216}{360}\times2\pi(45)=54\pi,\quad r=27.
\]
畢氏定理求垂直高度：
\[
h=\sqrt{45^2-27^2}=36\text{ cm}.
\]
容量：
\[
V=\frac13\pi(27)^2(36)=8748\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]

The height of the vessel is \(60\) cm. The vessel is placed on a horizontal table. Some water is now poured into the vessel. John finds that the depth of water in the vessel is \(28\) cm.

(a) Find the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) John claims that the volume of water in the vessel is greater than \(0.1\text{ m}^3\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
14. 一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個底半徑 \(72\) cm、高 \(96\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐的下部而成。容器的高度為 \(60\) cm，放在水平桌上。現將一些水倒入容器，John 發現水深為 \(28\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器的濕曲面面積。

(b) John 聲稱容器中的水體積大於 \(0.1\text{ m}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）

\frac13\pi r^2(16)=768\pi,\quad r=12.

\pi(12)\sqrt{12^2+16^2}=240\pi\approx754\text{ cm}^2.

13. \(ABCD\) is a trapezium with \(\angle ABC=90^\circ\) and \(AB\parallel DC\). \(E\) is a point lying on \(BC\) such that \(\angle AED=90^\circ\).

(a) Prove that \(\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD\).

(b) It is given that \(AB=15\) cm, \(AE=25\) cm and \(CE=36\) cm.

(i) Find the length of \(CD\).
(ii) Find the area of \(\triangle ADE\).
(iii) Is there a point \(F\) lying on \(AD\) such that the distance between \(E\) and \(F\) is less than \(23\) cm? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. \(ABCD\) 為梯形，\(\angle ABC=90^\circ\) 且 \(AB\parallel DC\)。\(E\) 為 \(BC\) 上的一點，使得 \(\angle AED=90^\circ\)。

(a) 證明 \(\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD\)。

(b) 已知 \(AB=15\) cm、\(AE=25\) cm 及 \(CE=36\) cm。

(i) 求 \(CD\) 的長度。
(ii) 求 \(\triangle ADE\) 的面積。
(iii) \(AD\) 上是否存在一點 \(F\)，使得 \(E\) 與 \(F\) 的距離小於 \(23\) cm？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Trapezium area = (a+b)h/2.
questions.solution: (a) Since \(AB\parallel DC\) and \(\angle ABC=90^\circ\), \[\angle ABE=\angle DCE=90^\circ.\] Also \(\angle AED=90^\circ\), so the remaining acute angles are equal. Hence \[\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD.\] (b)(i) \(BE=\sqrt{AE^2-AB^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20\text{ cm}.\) By similarity, \(\frac{CD}{BE}=\frac{CE}{AB}\) so \(\frac{CD}{20}=\frac{36}{15}\) and \(CD=48\text{ cm}.\) (b)(ii) The area of \(\triangle ADE\) is \(\frac12(AB+CD)(BC)-\frac12(AB)(BE)-\frac12(CD)(CE)\) \(=\frac12(15+48)(20+36)-\frac12(15)(20)-\frac12(48)(36)=750\text{ cm}^2.\) (b)(iii) \(AD=\sqrt{BC^2+(CD-AB)^2} =\sqrt{56^2+33^2}=65\text{ cm}.\) The shortest distance from \(E\) to \(AD\) is \(\frac{2(750)}{65}=\frac{300}{13}\approx23.1\text{ cm}.\) Since this is greater than \(23\) cm, there is no such point \(F\). Final answers: (a) proved; (b)(i) \(48\) cm; (b)(ii) \(750\text{ cm}^2\); (b)(iii) no.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）AB ∥ DC 且 ∠ABC = 90°，故 ∠ABE = ∠DCE = 90°。又 ∠AED = 90°，其餘銳角相等，故 △ABE ∼ △ECD。
（b）（i）BE = √(25²−15²) = 20 cm。由相似：
\[
\frac{CD}{20}=\frac{36}{15},\quad CD=48\text{ cm}.
\]
（b）（ii）△ADE 面積：
\[
\frac12(15+48)(56)-\frac12(15)(20)-\frac12(48)(36)=750\text{ cm}^2.
\]
（b）（iii）AD = √(56²+33²) = 65 cm。E 至 AD 最短距離：
\[
\frac{2(750)}{65}=\frac{300}{13}\approx23.1\text{ cm}.
\]
大於 23 cm，不存在此點 F。

(a) 求截頭錐 \(ABXY\) 的體積。

(b) 現將圓錐下部 \(VXY\) 沿圓 \(XY\) 向上推，造成圖 2 的容器。若將容器底平放，加水至溢出，求容器中的水量。兩個答案均以 \(\pi\) 表示。

(a) Find the base radius of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided by two planes which are parallel to its base. The top is a right circular cone \(X\), the middle is a frustum \(Y\) and the bottom is a frustum \(Z\). It is given that the ratio of the curved surface areas of \(X\), \(Y\) and \(Z\) is \(9:16:11\). Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的高及曲面面積分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(260\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的底半徑。

(b) 該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分：頂部為圓錐 \(X\)，中間為截頭錐 \(Y\)，底部為截頭錐 \(Z\)。已知 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\) 的曲面面積比為 \(9:16:11\)。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。

截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius be \(r\) cm. The slant height is \[\sqrt{r^2+24^2}.\] Since the curved surface area is \(260\pi\), \[\pi r\sqrt{r^2+576}=260\pi.\] Hence \[r^2(r^2+576)=260^2.\] So \[r^4+576r^2-67600=0.\] This gives \[(r^2-100)(r^2+676)=0.\] Rejecting the negative value, \[r=\boxed{10\text{ cm}}.\] (b) The curved surface areas of \(X\), \(X+Y\) and the whole cone are in the ratio \[9:(9+16):(9+16+11)=9:25:36.\] Therefore, the corresponding linear ratio is \[ 3:5:6, \] and the corresponding volume ratio is \[27:125:216.\] The volume of the whole cone is \[\frac13\pi(10)^2(24)=800\pi.\] Thus \[V_Y=800\pi\cdot\frac{125-27}{216} =\boxed{\frac{9800\pi}{27}\text{ cm}^3}.\]

(b) A solid metal sphere is then put into the cylindrical cup. The metal sphere is completely immersed in water and no water spills out of the cup. The total area of the wet surface of the cup is \(21.21\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(ii) Find the radius of the metal sphere.

13. 一個底半徑 \(4\) cm、高 \(5\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器盛水至深度 \(3.5\) cm。現將全部水倒入一個底半徑 \(2.1\) cm 的空直立圓柱杯，且沒有溢出。

(a) 求圓柱杯中水的深度。

(b) 再將一個實心金屬球放入圓柱杯，球完全浸入水中且沒有水溢出。杯的濕表面總面積為 \(21.21\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(i) Mark 聲稱水與金屬球的體積之和大於 \(55000\text{ mm}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
(ii) 求金屬球的半徑。

By similarity, \[\frac r4=\frac{3.5}{5},\] so \[ r=2.8. \] Let the depth of water in the cylindrical cup be \(h\) cm. Then \[\frac13\pi(2.8)^2(3.5)=\pi(2.1)^2h.\] Hence \[h=\boxed{\frac{56}{27}\text{ cm}}.\] (b)(i) Let \(H\) cm be the water depth after the sphere is put into the cup. \[
\frac43\pi R^3=\pi(2.1)^2\left(4-\frac{56}{27}\right),\quad R\approx1.85\text{ cm}.

It is given that the ratio of the height of the smaller circular cone removed to the height of the frustum is \(2:3\). Consider the solid \(P\) which is formed by fixing the frustum on top of a solid right circular cylinder of base radius \(10\) cm.

(a) Find the height and the base radius of the smaller circular cone removed.

(b) If the height of the circular cylinder is \(4\) cm, is the total surface area of solid \(P\) larger than \(1000\text{ cm}^2\)? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
10. 一個高 \(8\) cm 的截頭錐，由切除一個底半徑 \(10\) cm 的實心直立圓錐的上部造成。已知切除的小圓錐高與截頭錐高之比為 \(2:3\)。將該截頭錐固定在一個底半徑 \(10\) cm 的實心直立圓柱頂部而成的立體 \(P\)。

(a) 求切除的小圓錐的高及底半徑。

(b) 若圓柱的高為 \(4\) cm，立體 \(P\) 的總表面積是否大於 \(1000\text{ cm}^2\)？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution: (a) The height of the smaller cone removed is \[\frac23(8)=\boxed{\frac{16}{3}\text{ cm}}.\] Let its base radius be \(r\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{16/3}{16/3+8}=\frac{r}{10}.\] Thus \[\frac{16/3}{40/3}=\frac{r}{10},\] so \[r=\boxed{4\text{ cm}}.\] (b) The height of the original cone is \[\frac{16}{3}+8=\frac{40}{3}.\] Its slant height is \[\sqrt{10^2+\left(\frac{40}{3}\right)^2}=\frac{50}{3}.\] The curved surface area of the original cone is \[\pi(10)\left(\frac{50}{3}\right)=\frac{500\pi}{3}.\] The curved surface area of the smaller cone removed is \[\left(\frac{4}{10}\right)^2\left(\frac{500\pi}{3}\right)=\frac{80\pi}{3}.\] Hence the curved surface area of the frustum is \[\frac{500\pi}{3}-\frac{80\pi}{3}=140\pi.\] The exposed top circular face has area \[\pi(4)^2=16\pi.\] The curved surface area of the cylinder is \[2\pi(10)(4)=80\pi,\] and its bottom base has area \[100\pi.\] Therefore, the total surface area of solid \(P\) is \[16\pi+140\pi+80\pi+100\pi=336\pi\approx1055.6.\] Since \(336\pi>1000\), the total surface area is larger than \(1000\text{ cm}^2\).

Its volume is \(20736\pi-20736\pi\left(\frac{42}{48}\right)^3.\) \[=20736\pi\left[1-\left(\frac78\right)^3\right] \approx 21502.6\text{ cm}^3 =0.0215\text{ m}^3.\] Since \(0.2>0.0215,\) the vessel will overflow. \]

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(Y\) is a vessel in the shape of a frustum which is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone. The upper base radius of \(Y\) is \(24\text{ cm}\) and the lower base radius of \(Y\) is \(16\text{ cm}\). \(Y\) is similar to \(X\) in shape. \(Y\) contains \(3500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water. \(X\) is put into \(Y\) and \(X\) is totally immersed in the water without overflowing. (8 marks)
questions.stemZh:

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) \(Y\) 為一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個倒置直立圓錐的下部造成。\(Y\) 的上底半徑為 \(24\) cm，下底半徑為 \(16\) cm。\(Y\) 與 \(X\) 形狀相似。\(Y\) 盛有 \(3500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水。將 \(X\) 放入 \(Y\) 中，\(X\) 完全浸入水中且沒有溢出。某人聲稱 \(Y\) 中水深超過 \(15\) cm。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。

(a) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+36^2}=39.\] Its curved surface area is \[\pi(15)(39)=585\pi.\] Hence the curved surface area of the cone cut off is \[585\pi-325\pi=260\pi.\] Let the radius of the cone cut off be \(r\). Since curved surface areas of similar cones are in the square of the linear ratio, \[\left(\frac{r}{15}\right)^2=\frac{260}{585}=\frac49.\] Thus \[ r=10. \] The height of the cone cut off is \[\frac{10}{15}\times 36=24.\] Therefore, the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(15)^2(36)-\frac13\pi(10)^2(24) =2700\pi-800\pi =1900\pi.\] (b) Since \(Y\) is similar to \(X\), the linear scale factor from \(X\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{24}{15}=1.6.\] The smaller cone cut off from the larger inverted cone for \(Y\) has radius \(16\text{ cm}\), corresponding to radius \(10\text{ cm}\) in \(X\). 14. A solid right circular cone is divided into a circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane parallel to its base. The height and the base radius of \(X\) are 8 cm and 6 cm respectively. It is found that \(Y\) has the same volume as another right circular cone which has height and base radius equal to 13 cm and 18 cm respectively.

(a) Find the height of \(Y\).

(b) Express the total surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) \(Z\) is a sphere with surface area equal to the total surface area of \(Y\). Someone claims that the volume of \(Z\) exceeds the volume of \(Y\) by more than \(1000 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.

14. 一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(X\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(8\) cm 及 \(6\) cm。已知 \(Y\) 的體積等於另一個高 \(13\) cm、底半徑 \(18\) cm 的直立圓錐的體積。

(a) 求 \(Y\) 的高。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的總表面積。

(c) \(Z\) 為一個球，其表面積等於 \(Y\) 的總表面積。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的體積比 \(Y\) 的體積多超過 \(1000\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。

球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
14. (a) Volume of \(X=\frac{1}{3} \pi(6)^{2}(8) \mathrm{cm}^{3}\) \(=96 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Volume of \(Y=\frac{1}{3} \pi(18)^{2}(13) \mathrm{cm}^{3}\) \(=1404 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of \(Y\). 
 \[\left(\frac{8}{8+h}\right)^{3}=\frac{96 \pi}{96 \pi+1404 \pi}\] \[\left(\frac{8}{8+h}\right)^{3}=\frac{8}{125}\] \(h=12\) 
 ∴ The height of \(Y\) is 12 cm . } □

 ! for correct relation between volume ratio and length ratio 
 -- (3) (b) The lower base radius of \(Y=6 \times \frac{5}{2} \mathrm{~cm}=15 \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Total surface area of \(Y\) \(=\left\{\pi(6) \sqrt{6^{2}+8^{2}}\left[\left(\frac{5}{2}\right)^{2}-1\right]+\pi(6)^{2}+\pi(15)^{2}\right\} \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(\mathbf{1 M} \boldsymbol{+} \mathbf{1 M}\) 1 M for \(\pi r \ell\) 
 IM for using area ratio correctly \(=576 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) - (3) (c) Let \(R \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of \(Z\). \(4 \pi R^{2} =576 \pi \\ R^{2} =144 \\ R =12\) 
 Volume of \(Z=\frac{4}{3} \pi(12)^{3} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) \(=2304 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Volume of \(Z\) - volume of \(Y\) \[=(2304 \pi-1404 \pi) \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \(<1000 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Thus, the claim is incorrect. - (3) f.t.

questions.stem:
14. A solid metal right circular cone is divided into a circular cone X and a frustum Y by a plane parallel to
its base. It is given that the heights of X and Y are 45 cm and 30 cm respectively. The volume of Y is
31 360π cm³.

(a) Find the base radius of X . (3 marks)

(b) Express the total surface area of Y in terms of π. (2 marks)

(c) The base radius of a solid metal right cylinder Z is 32 cm. It is given that the total surface area of
Y is equal to the total surface area of Z. Express the volume of Z in terms of π. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。已知 \(X\) 及 \(Y\) 的高分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(30\) cm，\(Y\) 的體積為 \(31360\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求 \(X\) 的底半徑。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的總表面積。（2 分）

(c) 一個實心金屬直立圓柱 \(Z\) 的底半徑為 \(32\) cm。已知 \(Y\) 的總表面積等於 \(Z\) 的總表面積。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Z\) 的體積。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
questions.solution:
(a) Let the radii of X and the whole cone be r and R. Similarity gives \(R=5r/3\). Thus \(31360=\frac{30}{3}(R^2+Rr+r^2)=\frac{490}{9}r^2\), so \(r=24\) cm and \(R=40\) cm.

(b) Frustum slant height \(s=\sqrt{30^2+16^2}=34\) cm. Total area \(\pi(40+24)(34)+\pi(40^2+24^2)=4352\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(c) For the cylinder, \(2\pi(32)h+2\pi(32)^2=4352\pi\), so \(h=36\) cm and \(V=\pi(32)^2(36)=36864\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
